DIMM-DISPLAY.description: Dimension Line Show/Hide (DIMM-DISPLAY). Bulk-set the runtime view show/hide state of dimension lines — the same effect as the Works tree 'Dimension' context menu Show/Hide. The request body is carried under 'Argument'. The response is a flattened object { "CHANGED_COUNT": <int> }; CHANGED_COUNT is the number of dimensions whose display state actually changed. Requires an opened project. Non-existent DIMM keys are ignored.

KEYS.description: Target DIMM keys. Ignored when ALL=true; may be an empty array. Keys that do not exist are silently skipped.

ALL.description: Apply to all dimensions, ignoring KEYS. Optional; defaults to false.
